rows.section: Personal income tax scale 2026 (iedzīvotāju ienākuma nodoklis)
rows.basis: Annual taxable income (after contributions, the non-taxable minimum and reliefs), residents
rows.note: The 33% band starts at the maximum contribution base (€105,300 a year). Employers withhold 25.5% each month; the 33% band is settled in the annual return. A further 3% surcharge applies to total income above €200,000 (next section).
rows.source_title: Likumi.lv: likums "Par iedzīvotāju ienākuma nodokli" (consolidated text), 15. pants and pārejas noteikumu 202. punkts; VID: Iedzīvotāju ienākuma nodokļa likmes (atjaunināts 31.12.2025)

rows.section: Surcharge, wage tax and capital income 2026
rows.label: Additional rate (papildu likme) on total annual income above €200,000
rows.basis: The surcharge base is total annual income including capital income and certain exempt income; paid in the annual return
rows.note: The additional rate is not applied to income under the special royalty regime (transitional provision 200).

rows.section: Non-taxable minimum and dependant allowance 2026
rows.label: Non-taxable minimum per month (neapliekamais minimums)
rows.basis: Deducted from taxable income, whatever the income level (monthly in payroll where the wage tax book is filed with the employer)
rows.note: Non-residents get no non-taxable minimum unless resident elsewhere in the EU/EEA with more than 75% of their income from Latvia.

rows.note: The solidarity tax applies to employees and the self-employed whose income in the calendar year exceeds the maximum contribution base.

rows.section: Maximum contribution base and solidarity tax
rows.label: How it works
rows.value: During the year the normal contribution rate (34.09% for an employee) is paid on all pay above the base; after the year the tax is recalculated at 25% and the difference is refunded by 1 September of the following year
rows.basis: Annual contribution object (gross pay; the self-employed: declared income)
rows.note: The solidarity tax applies to employees and the self-employed whose income in the calendar year exceeds the maximum contribution base.
rows.source_title: VID: Solidaritātes nodoklis (atjaunināts 11.07.2026); VID: Solidaritātes nodokļa likmes (atjaunināts 11.07.2026)

rows.section: Maximum contribution base and solidarity tax
rows.label: Interaction with income tax
rows.value: Income above the maximum base is also in the 33% income tax band; 10% of the 25% solidarity tax is counted as income tax revenue
rows.basis: Annual contribution object (gross pay; the self-employed: declared income)
rows.note: The solidarity tax applies to employees and the self-employed whose income in the calendar year exceeds the maximum contribution base.
rows.source_title: VID: Solidaritātes nodoklis (atjaunināts 11.07.2026); VID: Solidaritātes nodokļa likmes (atjaunināts 11.07.2026)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Micro-enterprise tax (mikrouzņēmumu nodoklis)
rows.value: 25% of turnover, replacing income tax and the owner's social insurance; turnover up to the VAT registration threshold (€50,000); in force in 2026

rows.value: €17 a year or €9 a half-year, final tax; only for old-age pensioners or persons with a group 1 or 2 disability in listed crafts and household services, revenue up to €3,000, no employees
rows.note: Self-employed contribution rates and the micro-enterprise tax follow.

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Remote-work (digital-nomad) visa
rows.value: Yes: long-stay visa for up to 12 months, with one further visa of up to 12 months, for non-EU nationals employed by an employer in an OECD country or self-employed there; no right to work for Latvian employers
rows.note: Self-employed contribution rates and the micro-enterprise tax follow.
rows.source_title: PMLP: Ilgtermiņa vīzas saņemšana attālinātā darba veikšanai (atjaunināts 16.06.2026); Imigrācijas likums 11. panta 5. daļa (likumi.lv)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Remote-work visa: income requirement
rows.value: At least 2.5× the previous year's average monthly gross wage (€4,538 a month per PMLP), plus at least six months with the employer or six months of self-employed income
rows.note: Self-employed contribution rates and the micro-enterprise tax follow.
rows.source_title: PMLP: Ilgtermiņa vīzas saņemšana attālinātā darba veikšanai (atjaunināts 16.06.2026); Imigrācijas likums 11. panta 5. daļa (likumi.lv)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents

rows.note: Self-employed contribution rates and the micro-enterprise tax follow.
rows.source_title: Likumi.lv: likums "Par iedzīvotāju ienākuma nodokli" (consolidated text), 15. panta 19.2 daļa and pārejas noteikumu 195. punkts

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Inbound or expat tax regime
rows.value: No general regime for new residents: residents are taxed on the normal scale with the same non-taxable minimum and reliefs; the only arrival-related rate is the 15% option for remote-work visa holders
rows.note: Self-employed contribution rates and the micro-enterprise tax follow.
rows.source_title: Likumi.lv: likums "Par iedzīvotāju ienākuma nodokli" (consolidated text), 15. pants

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Application authority
rows.value: Remote-work visa: Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs (PMLP, Pilsonības un migrācijas lietu pārvalde); tax and social insurance registration: State Revenue Service (VID)
rows.note: Self-employed contribution rates and the micro-enterprise tax follow.
